sourceModifications: NEAR-only refresh-session hydration using the shared registration builder
Expanded benchmark assertions and safe server/confirmation timing collection
Preparation display helper moved to the NEAR display module
provenance.confirmation: Chromium virtual WebAuthn and automated secure confirmation; decision wait includes UI and automation work
limitations: Local Workers/D1 and stubbed chain RPC; no hosted or network optimization claim
Shared development machine; no benchmark-owned builds or audits during measurement
The incomplete expanded run (39 passed, one browser/page closure before registration completed) is retained separately and excluded
No Email OTP or latency distribution for refresh/unlock in this cohort
Reported iframe connection diagnostics are zero in the preconnected harness and do not attribute the public registration envelope
